attributes.name: Magus Arcana
attributes.powers:
Put this card on top of your deck to add your Intelligence die to your Strength or Dexterity combat check.

Put this card on top of your deck to reroll 1 die on your check; take the new result.

Put this card on top of your deck and bury a card of your favored card type to draw a card of the same type from your discard pile.

A magus learns the arcane secrets of both spellcraft and weaponcraft. This focus is almost palpable to the touch.
